name: SipArana Educational Web App
description: Sri Lanka's comprehensive digital learning platform for Grade 5 Scholarship (5 ශිෂ්‍යත්වය), Grades 6–13 (O/L, A/L), and University Higher Education, featuring Kavi Owl Mascot in simple Sinhala, step-by-step kid-friendly wizard, pictorial subject cards, color-coded daily timetable planner, AI Study Planner & Timetable Generator, Smart Flashcards, Real-Time Exam Countdown, Voice Notes & Audio Summaries, Google Student Hub, Free Courses radar, SipArana Book Shop, and multilingual support (Sinhala, Tamil, English).
